question.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $3?$

I. ${R}^{2}$

II. ${R}_{2}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $2$

III. ${\text{M}}_{3}(R),$ the vector space of all $3\times 3$ matrices over $R$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

I. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}^{2})=2\ne 3.\,\times 
  $$

II. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}_{2}[t])=2+1=3.\,✓
  $$

III. Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n}(R))={n}^{2}.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({\text{M}}_{3}(R))={3}^{2}=9\ne 3.\,\times 
  $$

Hence, the correct answer is "II only."
